title: review: G3 fix round 1: bounded_diff emits each hunk header once, render() stops re-bounding an already bounded diff, and the three acceptance tests in tests/test_spawn.py exist (review T-0309)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain 211e674 (T-0271, "bounded tool outputs") in git log; never drop or amend it.
Review T-0309 on T-0271, all to be addressed:
1. (high) orchestrator/spawn.py bounded_diff duplicates every hunk header: a line starting with '@@' is appended to hunks in the elif branch and again by the trailing unconditional startswith check that also matches '@@', so the flushed current block repeats it. Restructure so each header is appended exactly once; a one-hunk diff must yield exactly one '@@' line in the output.
2. (high) render() unconditionally re-runs bounded_diff on the diff kwarg although both call sites (review and spec-review prompt construction in spawn.py) already pass a bounded string, so the caller's worktree-and-scope-specific cap and expand hint are discarded (generic cap 12000, hint 'git diff') and the diffstat-prefixed text is parsed as a raw diff, duplicating headers again. Choose one bounding point: either the call sites pass the raw diff plus _diff_cap and _diff_hint and render() bounds once with them, or the call sites bound and render() passes the text through untouched. Apply the same rule to bounded_text for code excerpts. Both call sites must end with the scope-specific hint in the rendered prompt.
3. (high) tests/test_spawn.py has none of the tests the T-0271 acceptance names. Add test_bounded_diff_summary_first (diffstat summary precedes hunks), test_bounded_diff_expansion_hint (over-cap diff ends with the caller's hint naming the worktree and scope), test_review_prompt_diff_is_bounded (a review prompt built for a task with an over-cap scoped diff contains the summary, is under the cap and carries the hint once), test_bounded_diff_hunk_header_once (one-hunk diff yields one '@@' line), test_render_does_not_rebound_diff (passing an already bounded diff through the review render path yields exactly one summary block and one hint). Use the file's existing sandbox conventions.
Keep every T-0271 test green (tests/test_tests_green.py, recall changes untouched). Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with T-0335 in the message; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows 211e674 below your commit
bounded_diff on a one-hunk diff outputs exactly one line starting with '@@' (python -c check in the worktree)
orchestrator/spawn.py has a single bounding point per prompt: grep shows bounded_diff called either only in render() or only at the two call sites, not both
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

comments.issue: test_review_prompt_diff_is_bounded errors (not passes): it's missing the `(TMP / "wt" / review["id"]).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)` short-circuit every other run_worker/review test uses, so run_worker's ensure_worktree tries a real `git worktree add` against TMP and fails with 'not a git repository'. Verified by running the 5 new tests: 4 pass, this one errors. Violates acceptance criteria 2 and 5.

`reviewed["worktree"] = str(TMP)` mutates only the local dict; bus.get() reloads from disk so the field is never actually persisted (confirmed: bus.get(reviewed["id"])["worktree"] is None after run_worker). The assertion only passes because the test harness aliases spawn.ROOT to TMP, masking that this doesn't test the intended 'uses reviewed task's worktree' path. Use bus.update(reviewed["id"], worktree=str(TMP)) as done elsewhere in this file.
Review branch calls bus.get(t["inputs"][0]) twice plus once more inside scoped_diff() for the same task, unlike the spec_review branch which fetches src once and reuses it.
